description: Store screenshots with a title and your app’s screenshot in a drawn device, like the site’s Store Shots, at the sizes the stores ask for: iOS iPhone 6.9″ 1290×2796 (Apple scales it for every smaller iPhone), iPad 13″ 2064×2752; Android phone 1080×1920, tablet 1440×2560. Up to 10 per device for the App Store, 8 for Google Play. Templates: above (title at the top, device rising from the bottom), below (device above, title underneath), plain (rounded card, no device), tilted, bigtitle (large headline on the left), pair (two devices per slide, two screenshots each), iso (device turned in perspective), full (screenshot fills the image, title over a fade). JPEG (stores reject images with transparency), into a new folder in ~/Downloads/one-design. [Pro tool.]

background_image.description: An image to fill the background instead of the colour.

device.description: iPhone or iPad (iOS), phone or tablet (Android).

device_colour.description: Device colour: "dark", "light", or any hex colour.

font.description: Title font: sans (Inter) or serif (Instrument Serif); subtitles are sans.

platform.description: "ios" for the App Store, "android" for Google Play.

screenshots.description: Your app’s screenshots in the order they should appear (files or a folder). Each fills the device’s screen, cropped from the top.

slides.description: One title (and optional subtitle) per screenshot, in order. Missing ones get placeholder titles, so give one for each.

template.description: Layout: above, below, plain, tilted, bigtitle, pair, iso or full.

name: make_store_screenshots
title: Make App Store and Google Play screenshots
